notes.title: Sway
notes.note: A sway is a long note next to a short note, in either order. The simple rule: a short note followed by a long note. A long-short-long sandwich is the strongest, a super sway. Examples: bars 1 to 3 are the sandwich, a super sway. Pulse2 in bar 21 is a long note then a short one, some sway even though the next bar has no long note. Bar 4 beat 3 into bar 5 is long-short, but the long note never comes, so it turns into a melody run. Pulse2 can keep the sway going under a melody run, as in bars 5 and 6. The bass is not counted as contributing, for now.
